scripts.wp:restart: bash scripts/wp-env.sh stop && bash scripts/wp-env.sh start
scripts.wp:activate-campsite: bash scripts/wp-env.sh start && bash scripts/wp-env.sh run cli wp plugin activate vila-campsite-booking
scripts.wp:sync-campsite-bookings: bash scripts/wp-env.sh start && bash scripts/wp-env.sh run cli wp eval-file wp-content/plugins/vila-campsite-booking/resync-orders-cli.php
scripts.wp:clear-bookings: bash scripts/wp-env.sh start && bash scripts/wp-env.sh run cli wp eval-file wp-content/plugins/vila-campsite-booking/clear-bookings-cli.php
scripts.wp:seed: bash scripts/sync-theme-to-wp-env.sh && bash scripts/sync-vila-plugin-to-wp-env.sh && bash scripts/wp-env.sh start && bash scripts/wp-env.sh run cli sh -c 'cd /var/www/html && wp eval-file /var/www/html/wp-content/themes/vila-akoya/inc/seed-cli.php && wp theme activate vila-akoya'
scripts.wp:seed-acf-home: bash scripts/sync-theme-to-wp-env.sh && bash scripts/wp-env.sh start && bash scripts/wp-env.sh run cli sh -c 'cd /var/www/html && wp acf json sync 2>/dev/null || true && wp eval-file wp-content/themes/vila-akoya/inc/seed-acf-home-cli.php'
scripts.wp:seed-sections: bash scripts/sync-theme-to-wp-env.sh && bash scripts/wp-env.sh start && bash scripts/wp-env.sh run cli sh -c 'cd /var/www/html && wp acf json sync 2>/dev/null || true && wp eval-file wp-content/themes/vila-akoya/inc/seed-sections-cli.php'
scripts.wp:sync-seo: bash scripts/sync-theme-to-wp-env.sh && bash scripts/wp-env.sh start && bash scripts/wp-env.sh run cli sh -c 'cd /var/www/html && wp eval-file /var/www/html/wp-content/themes/vila-akoya/inc/seo-sync-cli.php'
